# Work Order

> Maintenance training for data center facility teams: preventive maintenance planning, mechanical systems, building maintenance, building envelope and roofing systems.

Work Order (https://dc-maintenance.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Preventive Maintenance Planning, Mechanical Systems Maintenance, Building Maintenance Fundamentals, Building Envelope Fundamentals or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://dc-maintenance.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Preventive Maintenance Planning](https://dc-maintenance.hazwoperosha.us/courses/preventive-maintenance-planning): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours. Reduce emergency repairs with a structured preventive maintenance program. Enroll: https://dc-maintenance.hazwoperosha.us/courses/preventive-maintenance-planning?buy=839
- [Mechanical Systems & Equipment Maintenance](https://dc-maintenance.hazwoperosha.us/courses/mechanical-systems-maintenance): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours. Hands-on mechanical maintenance — piping, chillers, and vibration diagnostics. Enroll: https://dc-maintenance.hazwoperosha.us/courses/mechanical-systems-maintenance?buy=838
- [Building Maintenance Fundamentals](https://dc-maintenance.hazwoperosha.us/courses/building-maintenance-fundamentals): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours. Core building maintenance fundamentals for facilities teams supporting critical infrastructure. Enroll: https://dc-maintenance.hazwoperosha.us/courses/building-maintenance-fundamentals?buy=1097
- [Building Envelope Fundamentals](https://dc-maintenance.hazwoperosha.us/courses/building-envelope-fundamentals): $99.99 per seat, 2 Hours. Understand how a facility's building envelope drives cooling load and energy cost. Enroll: https://dc-maintenance.hazwoperosha.us/courses/building-envelope-fundamentals?buy=1096
- [Roofing Systems Maintenance Fundamentals](https://dc-maintenance.hazwoperosha.us/courses/roofing-systems-maintenance-fundamentals): $99.99 per seat, 2 Hours. Preventive roofing maintenance to protect the facility below it. Enroll: https://dc-maintenance.hazwoperosha.us/courses/roofing-systems-maintenance-fundamentals?buy=1101

## Guides

- [Roof and envelope checks for data centers](https://dc-maintenance.hazwoperosha.us/guides/roof-and-envelope-checks): Water is a data center's enemy. Start at the top.
